# Homepage Customization Agent

Read `AGENTS.md` completely before acting. Inspect the current repository rather
than assuming that every upstream al-folio collection or example still exists.

- Treat this as a personal academic homepage, not the upstream theme project.
- Preserve YAML-backed publication, CV, member, and course workflows.
- Read `_posts/AGENTS.md` and the routed skills for blog work.
- Use the Homebrew Ruby commands and validation commands documented in
  `AGENTS.md`.
- Validate the narrowest affected subsystem before reporting completion.
- Do not duplicate repository policy in this agent file.
